feed.title: NPR Topics: News
feed.subtitle: Breaking news, top national and world stories, politics, business and culture from NPR. Catch up on demand with NPR News Now, Up First and Consider This.

entry.title: Mary Peltola flips Alaska's Senate seat into Democrats' column
entry.summary: Former Democratic Rep. Mary Peltola has narrowly won Alaska's U.S. Senate race, toppling the Republican incumbent, according to a race call by The Associated Press.

entry.title: Iran launches a third round of strikes on Bahrain, host of U.S. Navy's 5th Fleet
entry.summary: Iran fired drones on Tuesday at a U.S. radar facility in Bahrain, and the U.S. retaliated by firing at Iranian targets along an important shipping route.

entry.title: Nvidia board says it does not intend to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO
entry.summary: The former Nvidia CEO said he would be "honored" to return if the board allowed. But the board says it has no intention of reinstating him.

entry.title: Trump is in Asia ahead of Xi, Putin summit. And, tech leaders want Huang back at Nvidia
entry.summary: Trump says he plans to discuss Ukraine during his Asia trip, which contradicts what the White House previously announced. And, Silicon Valley leaders are pushing for Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia.

entry.title: Sen. Jack Reed says FAA needs a real plan, not just more money
entry.summary: Sen. Jack Reed raised concerns about FAA oversight of contractors after last week's nationwide ground stop and criticized the Trump administration's request for $50 billion in additional funding.

entry.title: Can Google win the AI race without killing its cash cow?
entry.summary: In late October, Google had the worst stock day in its history as a public company. The Planet Money newsletter asks: has Google been caught in "the innovator's dilemma"?

entry.title: I'm a human doctor with human intelligence. But I sure do like my AI notetaker
entry.summary: Has your doctor asked whether they can use artificial intelligence to take notes during an exam? It's very popular, and here's how to think through the pros and the cons of the new technology.

entry.title: Trump arrives in Philippines to kick off Asia trip
entry.summary: Manila is President Trump's first stop on a three-day trip that will later take him to China for historic three-way nuclear talks with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin.

entry.title: More people are getting the flu. Should you get a flu shot before you travel?
entry.summary: Thanksgiving is just around the corner, just as millions of Americans are expected to travel for the holidays. Another thing that's upon us? Cold and flu season.

entry.title: She went to college to become a social worker. Now she's joined the skilled trades
entry.summary: While the rise of AI continues to fuel the debate over whether college is worth the cost, apprenticeships in the skilled trades are having a moment, drawing in people of all backgrounds including college graduates.
